newsitem.title: SPAIN: Explosion in Basque town, ETA link reported.
newsitem.headline: Explosion in Basque town, ETA link reported.

text.p: An explosion occurred in an empty apartment in Spain's troubled Basque region on Thursday, police said.
Local news agency Europa Press, citing police sources, said the apartment in the town of Durango was a "safe house" for ETA Basque separatist guerrillas and one man had been arrested.
Rescue services said it appeared that no one had been hurt in the explosion, because they did not have to evacuate or treat anyone.
Police said the explosion had been triggered by materials in the apartment, where they found an arsenal of arms, and they were searching for the inhabitants.

ETA Basque separatist rebels provoked mass street protests throughout Spain after they killed a young town councillor at the weekend. Officials in the region have expressed fears the group would escalate its violent activity as a result.
Police found an ETA hideaway in Madrid earlier in the year when the rebels accidently set off an explosion.
